caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed object that resembles a wide, shallow bowl or chalice with a short pedestal base. The bowl is colored in shades of light gray and off-white, with subtle shading to suggest depth and a metallic or ceramic texture. The rim of the bowl is broad and flared, with darker shading along the edge and inner curves. The body of the bowl tapers inwards toward the pedestal, which is round and slightly flared at the bottom. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or decorations. In the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads “Lon Cronk.”
title: Silver Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
